summary.text: Wendell Walker is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 52nd District since 2020.
The district covers part of Campbell County and the City of Lynchburg.
The House profile lists Wendell Walker as retired.

paragraphs.text: Wendell Walker was born in Macon, GA.
The profile lists Liberty University (pastoral ministry, 1984) under education.
The profile lists Thomas Road Baptist Church under memberships and affiliations.
Wendell Walker serves on the Health and Human Services and Finance committees.
